select: select a.id, a.staff_id , b.id region_id , b.region_code, b.name as region_name, b.area_id , b.area_code , c.name as area_name from jml_staff_area a left join jml_region b on a.area_code = b.area_code left join jml_area c on b.area_code = c.area_code where a.staff_id = #{staffId} and a.enable = '1'

with recursive region_tree as ( select aa.* from jml_region aa inner join jml_staff_area aa1 on aa.area_code = aa1.area_code where aa1.staff_id = #{staffId} union all select bb.* from jml_region bb inner join region_tree cc on bb.parent_id = cc.id ) select distinct a.id, a.name, a.region_code, a.area_id, a.area_code, a.parent_id from region_tree a
